tables.name: Hardship Type
tables.description: Rolled once per hardship. The hardship's outcome modifies the attributes each type lists.

results.name: Plague
results.description: The community fell victim to disease. Modified attributes: population density.

results.name: Bandits on the Road
results.description: On the way to or from market, the village’s caravan was set upon by bandits. Modified attributes: population wealth.

results.name: Raid
results.description: The village was raided by marauders. Modified attributes: size, population wealth, population density.

results.name: Famine / Food Shortage
results.description: If the village normally produces some kind of food, it did not produce. If they typically get their food from the market, they had difficulties doing so for a time. Modified attributes: population density.

results.name: Harsh Weather
results.description: The region was beset by nature’s wrath. Modified attributes: condition, size.

results.name: Inter-Community Conflict/Violence
results.description: A conflict between members of the community broke out and split the village, with dire consequences. Modified attributes: population density, disposition.

results.name: Loss of Community Leader
results.description: A key member of the community died or went missing. Modified attributes: disposition.

results.name: Victim of War
results.description: The village was struck by the ravages of war (passing or foraging armies, collateral battle damage, disease from war-related issues such as camp hygiene or illness from dead bodies). Modified attributes: condition, size, population density.
